stream: For each horizon and starting label, query 1, ceil(denominator/2), the denominator, 1 again, the middle threshold again, then every unasked threshold alternating the smallest and largest remaining value. Interleave the six contexts in round-robin order.
store: Keep the live scan cursor, confirmed departures, and confirmed absences for each exact trace, horizon, starting label, window tuple and scan order. Changing just the threshold reuses that state's bounds. A second query may return without advancing the cursor.
control: Run each request starting cold with the same endpoint-first early-stopping scan. Require both answers to agree with the archived full count. Independently check every returned certificate's witnesses and complete absences. Count post-start label inspections only.
